evidence: When MIDI device is connected via connectMidiToTrack(), handleNoteOn creates AudioBufferSourceNode with rate=Math.pow(2,(note-24)/12), routes through velocity GainNode to trackGains[DRUMS_CFG.length+trackIndex], which feeds the full channel strip (fader→pan→mixBus→master). Note-off calls source.stop(). Mono tracks enforce single voice, poly tracks support up to 8 voices with oldest-voice stealing.
